interaction.author: agent
interaction.user_prompt: Post-release cleanup: signing preflight docs and tracker-reference removal
interaction.model_cot: Two decisions from the post-v0.5.0 audit. First, the release signing preflight belongs in public RELEASING.md because the release identity and public key are already public in every signed tag object; the public doc now records the Volute Release identity, the key fingerprint for pin-verification, the required config shape, a fail-fast preflight block before the ceremony, and the -c identity flags on the tag command, while key custody and location stay deliberately undocumented. Second, removed all 12 private-tracker references from the public tree: 11 code comments rewritten as self-contained behavioral statements and one user-facing Reviewer string that leaked a tracker ID. Repo-wide and history-wide sweeps found no other private-context leakage: no secrets, personal paths, or platform references across all 287 commits. New branch convention agreed: cleanup/ prefix for cleanup PRs.
